newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Asahimas opens Surabaya plant line.
newsitem.headline: Asahimas opens Surabaya plant line.

text.p: Indonesian glass maker PT Asahimas Flat Glass Ltd. Co. on Monday dedicated a second float line in its Surabaya plant after conducting some pre-operation running tests.

"The float line, mainly dedicated to the production of downstream glass products for both domestic and export makers, will commence commercial operation in July 1997," the company said in the statement.
The Surabaya factory initially built on 30 hectares, acquired an 20 additional hectares to host the new furnace.
The statement said this fourth production line would raise Asahimas' total production capacity from 420,000 million ton per annum to 570,000 million ton per annum.
Asahimas makes a wide-range of flat and fabricated glass for the property construction and automobile industries.
The company gave no further details.
